verdict.rationale: Headless or programmatic access is a fair question for a government filing and payment service, so the axis applies. The only evidence is two probes in which keyless agents hit Akamai 403 walls at both the front door and the MyFTB/Web Pay application host. Nothing documents a headless, API, or CI-usable automation path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
